# Installation configuration parameters for {{ ibm_cloud_title }} {#installation-config-parameters-ibm-cloud-vpc}

Before you deploy an OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ ibm_cloud_name }}, you give values for parameters to customize your cluster and the platform that hosts it.

When you create the `install-config.yaml` file, you give values for the required parameters through the command line. You can then change the `install-config.yaml` file to customize your cluster further.
